note: Absolute, user-facing latency budgets checked on every CI run (2-vCPU shared runner). They are deliberately generous: a violation means editing became perceptibly slow, not that a microbenchmark drifted. Baseline ratios are reported as warnings only.

budgets.why: a keystroke on a 1 MB document must stay well under one 60 Hz frame (16.7 ms) end to end; 20 ms allows runner noise
same keystroke budget with a 150-file workspace indexed
edits run on the event loop, scans on workers: a full re-index must not make typing lag noticeably (50 ms)
16 concurrent workspace searches, half cancelled, must not delay edits beyond 50 ms
a cancelled search must stop and answer within a quarter second
external changes must be noticed within a second (50 ms debounce + backend latency)
the request loop must never stall
rust-analyzer loading the workspace (another process) must not block editing; 100 ms allows CPU contention on 2 vCPUs
didChange is queued, never awaited: edits must stay interactive while rust-analyzer analyses each change
go-to-definition through rust-analyzer should answer within 2 s on a warm server
